svg.desc: Calls per second divided by @mapbox/polyline's in the same cell, log scale. Up is faster, down is slower. polytini 0.1.4, default import, precision 5. svg.text: Groups are points per line; "real" is the 1000 real-world lines, median 82 points. Between rounds a cell moved by a median of 5% to 7%, so bars closer than that are a tie.
Not drawn, to keep the scale readable: polyline-encoded (0.04x to 0.15x), @lp-labs/polyline-codec (0.12x to 0.36x).
Also not drawn: polytini's web and wasm entries. All of them are in docs/results.md.
